senses.gloss: ch. sameto drag, pull, push.—Part. pass. גְּרִיר dragged, following, guided by.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Exodus 14:25">Targ. Y. II, Ex. XIV, 25</cite> <he>גְּרֵירַן וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>גריד׳</he>) pushed from behind.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 18b:16">B. Kam. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>בתר גופיה גְּרִירִין</he> they are clinging to his body.
<cite ref="Taanit 24a:11">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>אנן בתרייהו גרירין</he> Rashi (ed. <he>גררינן</he>, read <he>גְּרִירִינָן</he>, Ms. M. <he>קאזלינן</he>) we must be guided by their order.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 72b:10">Ab. Zar. 72ᵇ</cite> all the wine in the barrel <he>אגישתא … ג׳</he> moves towards the siphon.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 85a:2">B. Mets. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>דג׳ עלמא וכ׳</he> that all the world followed David.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 8:16">Targ. Jud. VIII, 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01269"><he>גְּרַד</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 83b">Ḥull. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>ולִיגְרְרֵיה ונכסי</he> (Ar. <he>גרד</he>) let him scrape off the blood and cover it.
<cite ref="Berakhot 35b:18">Ber. 35ᵇ</cite> <he>כי היכי דנִגְרְרֵיה לליביה</he> (Ar. everywhere <he>גרד</he>) in order to stimulate his appetite.
<cite ref="Berakhot 35b:18">Ib.</cite> <he>טובא גָרֵיר</he> a large quantity has an appetizing effect.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140b:7">Sabb. 140ᵇ</cite> <he>משום דג׳</he> because it stimulates the appetite.
Esth. R. to I, 9 [read:] אנא מְגָרֵיר וכ׳ I will make their drinks appetizing (induce them to get intoxicated, interpreting Jer. LI, 39; differ. in comment.).—2) to saw off.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 33:20">Targ. Y. Deut. XXXIII, 20</cite> <he>דמְגָרֵר וכ׳</he> (or <he>דמַגְרַר</he> Af., ed. <he>דמִגְרַר</he>, corr. acc.) for he cuts off the arm &c. (II <cite ref="M02251"><he>מַפְרַק</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to be dragged. Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵈ large bags דארחיהון מִתְגָּרְרָה which are commonly dragged (not lifted).

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 22:8">Targ. Ps. XXII, 8</cite> <he>מִתְגָּרְרִין</he> (some ed. <he>מִתְגָּרְדִין</he>, ed. Lag. <he>מִתְגָּרִין</he>, fr. <cite ref="C01320"><he>גרי</he></cite>; h. text <he>יפטירו</he>).
